story: On 23 March 2023, eligible users could begin claiming ARB, the governance token associated with the Arbitrum DAO. Eligibility reflected activity recorded before a 6 February snapshot. This was a token-distribution and governance milestone, not the launch of the network: Arbitrum had already been operating on mainnet for nearly eighteen months.

Allocations varied with qualifying activity, including different weighting before and after the Nitro upgrade and checks intended to limit Sybil farming. Individual allocations ranged from 625 to 10,250 ARB. Receiving tokens opened a route to participation in governance. The giant suitcase does not specify an allocation or a token price.

A tortoise struggles to lift an oversized ARB suitcase from a baggage carousel. The joke turns claiming tokens into claiming luggage: the reward has arrived, but it is a lot to carry. The baggage hall, traveller and suitcase are imaginary, not a particular user's experience or a literal delivery of tokens. The caption WORTH THE WEIGHT. is wordplay, not an investment promise.

eggs.title: THE ARB SUITCASE
eggs.text: ARB identifies the governance token distributed in the airdrop. The oversized case makes the reward tangible, without representing a fixed allocation, value or physical weight.

eggs.title: THE LUGGAGE TAG
eggs.text: The large tag reads 087, the collector number of this card. It is not a wallet address, an eligibility score or the amount of ARB claimed.

eggs.title: THE MATCHING TAG
eggs.text: A second 087 tag sits in the traveller's pocket. Matching tags connect the tortoise to the case in the baggage-claim joke; they are invented props.

eggs.title: THE BLUE CHEVRONS
eggs.text: The blue diagonal accents echo Arbitrum's visual identity. They locate the metaphor without depicting a transaction interface, gas charge or network launch.

sourceNote: Sources: [Arbitrum Foundation: next phase of decentralization](https://blog.arbitrum.foundation/arbitrum-the-next-phase-of-decentralization/); [Official airdrop eligibility and distribution](https://docs.arbitrum.foundation/airdrop-eligibility-distribution). The tortoise, luggage and baggage hall are fictional metaphors. Tags identify card 087, not an allocation. WORTH THE WEIGHT. is editorial wordplay, not a quotation, valuation or promise of returns.
